subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose one process-wide `session-discussion` provider through the public plugin SDK and gateway, and if so what canonical agent-qualified session identity and plugin lifecycle semantics does that API guarantee?
rationale: This is a new exported plugin SDK entrypoint and additive gateway protocol surface; resolving the current bugs requires a durable contract decision rather than only local UI repairs.

options.title: Approve a scoped transactional seam
options.body: Define an agent-qualified provider input and require registration to snapshot, restore, and clear with plugin activation lifecycle before landing.

options.title: Keep this capability plugin-local
options.body: Do not add the generic core SDK/gateway surface until a concrete plugin proves a shared core contract is necessary.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Pause the PR until the plugin SDK and gateway owners specify provider cardinality, replacement behavior, and upgrade expectations.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped transactional seam
recommendation.body: Define an agent-qualified provider input and require registration to snapshot, restore, and clear with plugin activation lifecycle before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the only concrete author of the proposed public contract; an SDK/gateway owner should co-decide the permanent API shape.
